name: Western Ghats
fact: A UNESCO World Heritage mountain range that is older than the Himalayas, and one of the world's biodiversity hotspots.

name: Lakshadweep
fact: 36 coral islands in the Arabian Sea: India's smallest union territory.

name: The Arabian Sea
fact: Sailors have ridden the monsoon winds across this sea between India and Arabia for more than 2,000 years.

name: Ras al Hadd, Oman
fact: The easternmost tip of the Arabian Peninsula, where endangered green turtles come ashore to nest.

name: Muscat, Oman
fact: Oman's capital. Its Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque holds one of the largest hand-woven carpets in the world.

name: Jebel Shams
fact: The 'Mountain of the Sun': about 3,000 m tall, the highest peak in Oman's Hajar Mountains.

name: Fujairah, UAE
fact: The only one of the seven emirates whose whole coastline faces the Gulf of Oman instead of the Persian Gulf.

name: Burj Khalifa, Dubai
fact: At 828 m, the world's tallest building since 2010. Look for it on your approach!
